integrity: The analytic result is supported by a self-contained characteristic-polynomial and Jordan proof and an independently assembled finite-matrix checker. Independent external scientific validation is not performed.
scientific_limitations: A finite-dimensional one-particle tight-binding weighted star with two equal active spoke couplings, real passive spoke couplings and zero real onsite detuning. No claim is made about metric graph operators, nonlinear or many-body systems, or independent historical priority.
title: A neutral spoke abolishes the real-spectrum threshold of a gain–loss quantum trimer
